channel.title: Jino Sabu — Recent Updates
channel.description: Release notes for the portfolio and the in-browser toolkit — every update, dated and versioned.

item.title: v7.9 — The subscribe button no longer dumps a wall of XML in your face.
item.description: The subscribe button no longer dumps a wall of XML in your face. It opens a small sheet instead: what the feed is, the address on one tap to copy, and buttons that open it straight in a reader. The raw XML is still one link away for anyone who wants it. While checking the icons on the new sheet we found some of them were coming out empty - the icon font was missing a few of the glyphs it referenced - so the icon font was rebuilt and a couple of blank buttons around the site now show their symbol again.

item.title: v7.8 — Three fixes you asked for.
item.description: Three fixes you asked for. The top of the page no longer sits flush against the screen: it now keeps clear of the notch and the status bar on a phone and leaves a little breathing room everywhere else. The site name that lives in the OS title bar was being painted even when the browser had no title bar for it, so it overflowed the top of the screen and was cut in half at the corner - it now only appears when there is a real title bar to sit in. Recent Updates is a fixed panel that scrolls inside itself instead of a long section you have to scroll past, with the version and the sync controls pinned at the top. And the release feed is findable again: a subscribe row now sits right under the toolbar, so the RSS link is always one tap away.

item.title: v7.7 — A broken link, found by checking every link on this site.
item.description: A broken link, found by checking every link on this site. The Carroms Pool live demo pointed at a repository name that no longer exists, so the button returned a 404 - it now points at the game. The README was rewritten as well: the old one still showed a social preview image that was never in the repository, documented a habit tracker that was removed months ago and keyboard shortcuts that no longer exist, and said nothing about the share sheet, the file handlers, the title-bar overlay or the release feed.

item.title: v7.6 — The updates feed is live.
item.description: The updates feed is live. Recent Updates now has an RSS endpoint - feed.xml - carrying every dated, versioned release note, with a link in the page head so feed readers and browsers discover it on their own, and a subscribe button beside the version chip for everyone else. The feed is generated from the same array the page renders, so it can never drift from what a visitor actually sees, and it is rebuilt automatically every time a new version ships.

item.title: v7.5 — The operating system can now hand things to this site.
item.description: The operating system can now hand things to this site. Share a link, a snippet or a photo to it from any other app and the content arrives in the tool that owns it - text and links land in the Clipboard, images and PDFs go straight into the Scanner batch queue, a Markdown file opens as a new Scratchpad note, a CSV becomes a set of Counters and a backup JSON restores into the Data Vault. Opening a file with the app now routes it by extension instead of downloading it. Installed as a desktop app, the window controls no longer sit on top of the content: the top strip is reserved and the name moves into it. Also fixes a real export bug - every Export as .csv was throwing because the cell helper it relied on was missing.

item.title: v7.4 — Interface and layout pass across the whole site.
item.description: Interface and layout pass across the whole site. Every piece of muted text now clears the WCAG AA contrast bar - it was sitting at roughly three to one against the light surfaces, so labels, captions and metadata are properly legible instead of merely present. The accent chips keep their colour but use a darker ink, the touch targets that were only twelve pixels wide are now a full forty-four, the colour swatches and the password slider carry real labels, and every horizontal rail fades out on the side that still has content, so a cut-off row reads as scrollable rather than broken. The bottom dock is frosted glass and now sits on a soft scrim, so the last row of icons dissolves under it instead of being sliced in half. The clipboard panel fits one phone screen instead of two: four compact stat tiles, the capture buttons on a single line, and the export and filter rows scrolling sideways behind a fade. The toolkit sheet no longer leaves a third of the display empty under the tool grid - it fits its content now and grows to full height only when a tool is actually open. On a wide screen the hero becomes a real two-column split: the name and the role on the left, the introduction and the stat rail on the right, under a ruled masthead with the portrait. All five Focus mode chips carry their interval now, including Custom. Same palette, same type, same shapes - just easier to read and use.

item.title: v7.3 — QR Studio layout fix for phones.
item.description: QR Studio layout fix for phones. The payload under the code no longer runs off the edge of the sheet - a long link now wraps inside the panel instead of being clipped mid-word - and the whole preview is a single column on a phone: a centred 190px code, the payload underneath it, Download PNG across the full width with Copy Image and Share side by side, and the send chips wrapping onto two rows instead of one chip per row. The type rail now scrolls with a snap so the last chip is always reachable. The desktop layout is unchanged.

item.title: v7.2 — Scanner and Passwords pass.
item.description: Scanner and Passwords pass. Detected secrets - OpenAI, GitHub, AWS, Google, Slack and Stripe keys, JWTs, private keys, bearer tokens, database URLs - now render masked in the password vault and in the clipboard, each with its own reveal toggle, a type badge and an automatic re-mask, and the secret itself never reaches the DOM. The scanner reads whole batches now: images plus multi-page PDFs, with pdf.js lazy-loaded and every page rasterised and read. Each result offers the action that fits it - open, copy or shorten a URL, compose a mailto, dial a tel, drop a geo on the map, turn a calendar event into a Mission with its due time, or hand a UPI link to your payment app. A printable Wi-Fi join sheet turns a scanned network into an SSID, password and QR card you can leave for guests. The curated featured-repositories strip and the QR Studio quiet-zone and error-correction sliders are gone; the generator now always uses a 4-module quiet zone and level-H error correction so logo-watermarked codes stay scannable.

item.title: v7.1 — Toolkit focus pass.
item.description: Toolkit focus pass. The Focus timer and the Stopwatch now run off an absolute wall-clock timestamp instead of a decrementing counter, so they stay accurate through a backgrounded tab, a screen sleep or a reload, and a running timer comes back exactly where it left off. Counters can roll over on their own - daily, weekly or monthly, with the hour you want the reset to land - so a weekly tally starts fresh without a manual reset. Every snippet, scan, QR, timer session and counter can now be sent straight to another tool: Clipboard, Scratchpad, Missions, Counters, Focus, QR Studio or the Focus Log, from one shared action row. No new tools and no new dependencies.

item.title: v7.0 — Home hero rebuilt as an editorial split: the name leads at display size, the role reads as a mono eyebrow, the…
item.description: Home hero rebuilt as an editorial split: the name leads at display size, the role reads as a mono eyebrow, the three stat boxes collapse into a single hairline rail, and the primary action gains a weighted arrow cap with matched ghost buttons beside it. The portrait is now a compact 44px chip in the top corner, the availability dot is gone for good, and the whole block is tightened to sit in one screen on a phone. Light mode, reduced motion and Performance mode are all respected - no new dependencies.

item.title: v6.9 — Perf pass: fonts and icons are now self-hosted and subset (Inter, JetBrains Mono and only the 184 Font Awesome…
item.description: Perf pass: fonts and icons are now self-hosted and subset (Inter, JetBrains Mono and only the 184 Font Awesome glyphs in use - about 78 KB total, zero third-party requests). Notes, counters, clipboard, focus and vault panels no longer render at boot; they build the first time you open a sheet. GitHub and Gumroad data now come from scheduled JSON snapshots in feeds/, so rate limits and CORS can no longer break the dashboard. sw.js got a versioned cache and a fresh strategy, and the availability pill is gone.

item.title: v6.8 — Support goal rebuilt as a Studio Fund card: Rs 5,000 target with real milestone steps, live progress bar, lock-free…
item.description: Support goal rebuilt as a Studio Fund card: Rs 5,000 target with real milestone steps, live progress bar, lock-free perks and one-tap Contribute / Patreon actions - no invented numbers (set SUPPORT_GOAL.raised, or point SUPPORT_GOAL.syncUrl at a JSON file to update it without a redeploy). Experience is now a horizontal snap rail with expandable descriptions instead of a tall column.

item.title: v6.7 — Removed the custom long-press/right-click menu so the native browser menu works again.
item.description: Removed the custom long-press/right-click menu so the native browser menu works again. Home now shows a live studio snapshot (real GitHub repo + star counts and live product count) instead of a money goal. The store shows real catalog facts (product count, price range, last update) plus an auto-detected newest drop. Experience rebuilt as cards, and the fake milestone roadmap is gone.

item.title: v6.6 — Section navigation moved out of the hero into its own quick-nav strip.
item.description: Section navigation moved out of the hero into its own quick-nav strip. Bottom dock redesigned with an accent-tinted active indicator, a raised tools button and larger tap targets. Recommendations rebuilt as swipeable cards with initials avatars, project chips, verified marks and a Read more toggle.

item.title: v6.5 — Home screen rebuilt for clarity and speed: status pill with availability, live local clock, at-a-glance stats,…
item.description: Home screen rebuilt for clarity and speed: status pill with availability, live local clock, at-a-glance stats, section-jump chips, a labelled Connect group and a dock that slides away while you read and returns on scroll-up. Selected Works now shows Lumiere, SonicForge and Carroms Pool Game with cover-art cards and one-tap Live demo. Scrolling is smoother on phones: rAF-throttled scroll feedback, decorations paused mid-swipe, lighter glass on touch devices, a reading-progress hairline and a Performance mode toggle.

item.title: v6.4 — Selected Works refreshed: Lumière (image editor) and SonicForge (audio editor) replace Monadio and Modus Audio in a…
item.description: Selected Works refreshed: Lumière (image editor) and SonicForge (audio editor) replace Monadio and Modus Audio in a new cover-art card layout with a one-tap Live demo button. Scrolling is finally smooth on phones: rAF-throttled scroll feedback, decorative animations paused mid-swipe, lighter glass blur on touch devices and a new Performance mode toggle. Plus a reading-progress hairline, tappable carousel dots, keyboard-scrollable rails and a hero header that no longer wraps to four lines on small screens.

item.title: v6.3 — Complete Scratchpad revamp: library-first design with rich note cards, pin/filter/search everywhere, autosave while…
item.description: Complete Scratchpad revamp: library-first design with rich note cards, pin/filter/search everywhere, autosave while typing, sticky editor toolbar with overflow actions, and a split-screen workspace on desktop — all smoother and faster on every device.
